title: Amending pleadings
summary: Amendment changes a party’s pleading as the case develops. The rules distinguish changes allowed without permission from those requiring consent or leave of court, and address the effect on timing and trial.
notes: Permission to amend does not itself establish that an otherwise late claim relates back. Nor does a change in proof automatically show consent to try a new issue.

sections.Meaning: Amendment changes a party’s pleading as the case develops. The rules distinguish changes allowed without permission from those requiring consent or leave of court, and address the effect on timing and trial.
sections.How to work through the question: Identify the stage, the proposed change, delay, good faith, prejudice, and whether the amendment would be legally futile. Beeck considers withdrawal of an admission; Krupski concerns relation back after the limitations period.
